text: Real GDP grew 7.8% in Q1 FY27 (April–June 2026), ahead of the RBI's 7% projection. Nominal growth was 10.3%, investment rose 11.9% and consumption 7.1%.
note: 7.8%, 10.3% nominal, 11.9% GFCF and 7.1% PFCE read from the MoSPI press note of 31 Aug 2026. The RBI's 7.0% Q1 FY27 projection is from the Monetary Policy Statement of 5 Aug 2026 (https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63287). The phrase 'the fastest quarter in two years' was REMOVED on 13 Sep 2026: MoSPI's own quarterly series shows Q2 FY26 at 8.1% and Q4 FY26 at 8.6%, both above 7.8%.
